request.ambition: A garden has three circular beds with radius 2 metres each. How many litres of mulch are required for a uniform 3-centimetre depth? Provide the calculation and round up to whole litres.
request.originalAmbition: A garden has three circular beds with radius 2 metres each. How many litres of mulch are required for a uniform 3-centimetre depth? Provide the calculation and round up to whole litres.

receipt.objective: Calculate the total mulch required in litres for three circular beds with radius 2 metres and a 3-cm depth.
receipt.nextAction: Compute the volume of mulch for one circular bed and multiply by three, then convert to litres.
receipt.work:
Area of one circular bed = π × r² = π × 2² = 4π m².
Depth = 3 cm = 0.03 m.
Volume per bed = area × depth = 4π × 0.03 = 0.12π m³ ≈ 0.377 m³.
Total volume for three beds = 3 × 0.377 = 1.131 m³.
Convert to litres: 1 m³ = 1000 litres → 1.131 × 1000 = 1131 litres.
Rounded up to whole litres: 1131 litres.
